title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical mirror
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical mirror selfie portrait of a young adult woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, with an East Asian appearance, relaxing casually in a modest, softly illuminated modern bedroom. She has a slender, naturally proportioned figure, smooth fair skin with delicate warm ivory undertones, a graceful shoulder line, and long, slender fingers. Her face is almost entirely concealed behind a large silver-white smartphone held vertically directly in front of her face, making her eyes, nose, lips, and facial expression invisible. Only subtle glimpses of her forehead and hairline can be seen above the phone, creating a mysterious, intimate, effortlessly candid atmosphere.

Her long, thick, straight dark chocolate-brown hair falls naturally past her shoulders, with a slightly tousled texture, subtle warm reflections, and soft flyaway strands. Her head is angled slightly downward toward the phone screen, suggesting a relaxed, private moment. Her visible expression remains deliberately obscured rather than artificially reconstructed.

She wears an oversized, soft heather-gray zip-up hoodie made from thick, comfortable cotton fleece, with loose sleeves, broad ribbed cuffs, visible seams, and a relaxed drape across her torso. The hoodie has slipped naturally off one shoulder, revealing her bare shoulder, upper arm, and a narrow white inner garment strap. The open neckline forms soft diagonal folds across her upper chest. Her clothing appears genuinely casual and slightly disheveled, with realistic fabric thickness, subtle wrinkles, and natural shadows. One knee is raised prominently toward her chest in the foreground, emphasizing her comfortably curled-up seated posture, while the remainder of her lower body is mostly outside the frame.

Her hand dominates the center foreground, holding a pale silver-white iPhone with three prominent rear camera lenses, a transparent protective case, a visible circular MagSafe ring, and a small banknote tucked inside. Her fingers extend diagonally across the phone, displaying long, delicately tapered fingernails with a pale pink-and-white manicure.

The background features a lived-in contemporary bedroom with warm off-white walls, a tall dark wooden open shelving unit on the left, an open doorway, and a wall-mounted wooden desk supporting a small black television on the right. An unmade bed with gray bedding, a rumpled cream-colored blanket, and soft pillows occupies the right side of the composition. Muted brown flooring and understated furniture establish a realistic domestic setting.

Capture the photograph from a close, slightly elevated mirror-selfie perspective using a 26mm smartphone-equivalent lens, natural handheld framing, subtle wide-angle perspective, soft indoor ambient lighting, gentle shadow transitions, realistic skin pores, fine hair detail, authentic fabric textures, restrained digital noise, and a muted warm-neutral cinematic color grade. Preserve the spontaneous, unretouched smartphone photography aesthetic, with moderate depth of field, natural proportions, subdued contrast, and believable everyday realism. Vertical composition, aspect ratio 3:4.
